name: print-social-forest-lake-photo-cover-with-huge-cyrillic-caps
title: Woman on a lakeside bench with giant white geometric caps and a small vertical caption
whatItIs: A green forest lake photo with a woman in a white floral dress seen from behind on a bench. Giant white geometric sans words 'КОМФОРТ САМОПІЗНАННЯ' fill the upper part with a small rotated caption at the left and a wordmark at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Serene and reflective; huge clean caps over quiet nature feel editorial.
techniques: Place enormous geometric caps in the sky area of a photo.
Rotate a small caption beside the giant word.
Keep the palette from the photo (green, cream).
Put a small wordmark centred at the base.

vocabulary.definition: Very large uppercase words used as the main graphic.
Small vertical text next to a big word.
A cover where the image sets the mood.
Sans letters built from circles and lines.
